analysis: Docs-only change to docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch updates the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and adds one troubleshooting row (about line 2555, beyond the supplied head excerpt) describing load refusal during an add-on hold. I examined the supplied head text (lines 1-805) and found no code, configuration, key-handling, wire-format or access-control changes. The large Nemotron Super and prefix-cache prose is unchanged context. It already describes existing behavior consistent with T-041. Durable SSD checkpoints are scoped by coordinator-authored cache scope, encrypted, TTL-bound and identity-bound to the pinned artifact hash. Nothing here loosens the production gate, TTL, name derivation or scope handling, and no new attack surface is introduced. The added hold row relates to TB-012, A-018 and T-059 (local add-on hold socket). It is only visible as a truncated patch excerpt, so I could not verify its full text. Whether the documented load-gate behavior matches code, and whether the coordinator handles the busy fields, is outside the supplied evidence (platform-owned per the threat model). I recommend no deeper review beyond confirming the truncated row stays consistent with TB-012/T-059; no security conclusion depends on it.
